subject: Finding stuff
author: SUFFUR
body:
If you find stuff, then your learning the world, then learning to race around the world, hence around the world races, which, gets rid of racing tracks, and the muscle memory, will be more universal, I am not saying it will be better than Revenge, for boost jumping, and repeative tracks, and serious lap times, but building your own routes, having 3 or 4 types of boost, or just burning from one place to another, sounds like fun for a month, then its creating routes, that have to use short cuts, jumps of doom, with a twist to show off to the people behind, and taking someone down, is now a challenge, (i hope, not because i have to find them, but when i do, I have a battle, where bits of car can be followed to a mess, of their distruction, that i caused, sawheat). Revenge racers might not like it, but I bet most of them will give it a go, say it's not Revenge and live with it, and then find something in Paradise to compete for, and we will all be happy bunnies, and eat chocolate, and find girl/boy friends,  get married, have kids, and tell them stories of who was the best white mountain glitcher, and Boot will have his chopper and a small dog, and ...read one of my older blogs, that talks about racing around a realistic world, but with burnout handling... i have got bored bye.

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?

subject: Maybe it's just me...
author: FrozenVapor
body: But I'm really just hoping the racing action is good in Paradise. Stuff like finding all the billboards might be fun for the first few weeks, but eventually I imagine it'll probably get boring. The racing is what holds Burnout together, so hopefully the racing turns out awesome on the demo.
